_comment: Historical base rates per predicate. rate_per_Nd = P(event occurs in N days) derived from academic literature.

resign.notes: ~8% of incumbent leaders exit per 6-month window; higher for parliamentary systems

removal.notes: Forced removal (vote of no confidence, impeachment); distinct from voluntary resignation

election_win.notes: By definition either wins or loses; 0.50 prior, strong signal moves this

coup.notes: ~4% annual coup attempt rate in historically coup-prone states; adjust by fragility

ceasefire.notes: Conditional on active armed conflict; very high variation by conflict stage

military_escalation.notes: Conditional on existing low-level hostilities; high base rate reflects ICEWS labeling

nuclear_event.source: NTI Nuclear Security Index + historical incidents
nuclear_event.notes: Extremely rare; proxy: nuclear-armed state + crisis escalation ladder

interest_rate_change.source: FOMC decision data 1994-2024 (Fed, ECB, BOE, BOJ aggregated)
interest_rate_change.notes: Rate of policy rate change per meeting varies strongly with inflation regime

recession.notes: Unconditional annual probability; conditional on yield curve inversion: ~0.65 per year

default.notes: Sovereign default; conditional on debt stress: ~0.18/yr

extradition.notes: Conditional on outstanding request + treaty; execution often takes years

arrest.source: ICC/ICJ case completion rates + domestic prosecution data
arrest.notes: Conditional on active warrant; highly jurisdiction-dependent

indictment.notes: Conditional on active investigation; grand jury indictment rate ~90% when case is filed

conviction.source: DOJ conviction statistics (federal cases go 90% conviction rate once indicted)

perform.notes: Major artists tour ~every 2 years; conditional on past tour patterns

visit.notes: Artist/celebrity visit to specific country; depends on visa, market, past presence

music_release.notes: Major artists release ~every 2-3 years; indie artists more frequent

unknown.notes: Used when predicate not recognized; conservative center-of-prior

horizon_scaling.notes: Assumes constant hazard (exponential survival). Approximation — real hazards are non-constant.
